# plugin and run_plugin both use fs, so they take pre/post only (no ex lines).

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return fs.read(path) and fs.read("notes/../secret.txt"), each empty on failure, joined by "|"."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs confined to the notes directory; path is relative to notes."""
    pre not path.startswith("/")
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
